_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
Droe neuh Pemain {player_id} lam permainan Liar's Dice ngon {num_players} pemain.
Aturan:
- Bak giliran droe, droe jeuheut:
  1) Bikin tawaran baru ngon kuantitas nyang leubeh tinggi atawa nilai muka nyang leubeh tinggi (atawa duwa-duwa) dari tawaran nyang atra; mis. '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Neupanggil tawaran nyang atra ngon mengetik '[Call]'.

Jika droe neupanggil:
  - Jika jumeulah dadu nyang sesuai ngon nilai muka nyan kurang dari tawaran, pemain nyang neutawar atra kehilangan dadu.
  - Laen, pemain nyang neupanggil kehilangan dadu.
Pemain nyang jumeulah dadu nyan 0 tereliminasi. Pemain nyang tinggai menang.

board.new_round:
Ronde baru - Dadu nyang sisa: {dice_summary}
Dadu droe atra: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Pemain {current_player_id} neupanggil! Jumeulah dadu ngon nilai muka {face_value} nyan {count}, nyang kurang dari {quantity}.
Pemain {loser_id} (pemain nyang neutawar atra) kehilangan dadu.
call.caller_loses:
Pemain {current_player_id} neupanggil! Jumeulah dadu ngon nilai muka {face_value} nyan {count}, nyang leubeh dari atawa sama ngon {quantity}.
Pemain {loser_id} (pemain nyang neupanggil) kehilangan dadu.

invalid_move.not_recognized: Aksi hana diakui sebagai '[Bid: X, Y]' atawa '[Call]' nyang sah. Aksi nyang diserah: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: Kuantitas baru {new_quantity} kurang dari kuantitas atra {current_quantity}.
bid_reason.face_lower: Nilai nominal baro {new_face_value} leubeh rendah dari nilai saat nyo {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.identical: Tawar nyan identik deungen tawar saat nyo.

message.eliminated_invalid: Peunampilan {player_id} ji eliminasi le langkah hana sah.
